source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
Planting method: plant by digging a small hole and sowing, or by dibbling seed directly into the soil in one motion. Sow 2 to 3 seeds per hole/hill. Plant in rows with hills spaced along the row.

Two recommended spacing patterns are given:
- Row spacing of 75 cm with hill spacing of 30-40 cm within the row, or
- Row spacing of 75 cm with hill spacing of 50-60 cm within the row.

Planting depth depends on the season: in the rainy season, plant at a depth of about 3-5 cm; in the dry season, plant deeper, at about 5-8 cm (when planting with irrigation), so the seed reaches available soil moisture.
